title: DCCM: Dungeon Crawler Carl in Doom - one(ish) shot with Fable
author: rise_xyz
selftext:
Late to the DCC party, but just in time to oneshot DCCM - Doom-inspired DCC demo. I instructed Claude to source all the art assets, which it did (either open common license packs, or procedurally generated). I added a few details from the books, but Claude also did a deep dive on Reddit / Fandom and dug out a few other details. It added the text-to-voice of the AI including flavourful sarcasm and humor (attempts!), ambient audio, and ofc controls, procedural dungeon creation, HUD etc. About 90% of this came from a single prompt.

I continued with a bit of noodling just for accessibility: minimap, control tuning, canonical story events, bathrooms/saferooms/ enemy types (lave-breathing llamas), Princess Donut powers, and ofc toggleable Doom-style gore. 

I was impressed it produced so much out the box, but, yknow... room for improvement.
